# evroc_hotswap_disk_attachment (Data Source)

Retrieves information about an existing evroc disk attachment.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Name of the disk attachment to query.

### Optional

- `project` (String) Project this resource belongs to. Defaults to the provider project.

### Read-Only

- `attachment_id` (String) Unique identifier of the disk attachment.
- `created_at` (String) Timestamp when the disk attachment was created.
- `disk` (String) Name of the attached disk.
- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `region` (String) Region where the disk attachment is located.
- `serial` (String) Serial identifier of the attached disk.
- `virtual_machine` (String) Name of the virtual machine the disk is attached to.
